The InfluenceHER Collective™ · Campaign Film · Reels Edition

👑 Anthem Storyboard — “By Whom”

Fourteen frames, now built natively vertical (9:16) for Reels, TikTok, and Shorts — recomposed for portrait, not cropped. Gold-bordered frames are the signature hybrid device: real cinematography meeting the app's own painted world, generated at 4K against the app's actual artwork. The film opens and closes on the device so it reads as brand language.

Hybrid Signature · Roots

1 · The Mirror of Vision

“Someone will shape how our girls see themselves.”

The device, in shot one: her reflection is painted in the app's gouache style, crowned, gold spilling into the real room.

Rise · The Problem

2 · The Noise

“The question is not whether she's being influenced —”

“— the question is by whom.”

Mom leans in; warm light replaces the cold screen.

Hybrid Signature · Transition

5 · Paint Becomes Real

“The InfluenceHER Collective. A modern-day village —”

She walks out of the painted world into a real school hallway — the watercolor dissolves above her as she comes toward camera. Built vertical: the seam runs top-to-bottom.

The Collective

6 · The Circle

“— where mentors and coaches pour into her,”

Chicago at dusk, string lights, real laughter.

Rise · Ages 10–13

7 · Voice

“where she learns to use her voice,”

She stands and the classroom turns toward her.

Hybrid Signature · Bloom

8 · Presence

“own her presence,”

Real girl at the podium while the app's painted gold sunburst climbs the full vertical frame, crown floating above her head. The strongest phone-screen shot in the film.

Flourish · Ages 19–39

9 · Influence

“and turn influence into legacy.”

A Flourish-stage woman coaches the next girl up — the pathway loops back.

Legacy · 40+

10 · Legacy

“Because understanding who she is —”

Golden hour porch, grandmother and granddaughter, monarch butterfly overhead.

Hybrid Signature · Hero

11 · We Are The Influence

“— is her superpower. Every Black girl deserves a village.”

Five real generations clustered inside the painted world, a crown above each head, top third clear for the title.

CTA · Closing Card

12 · Get the App

“We InfluenceHER — coming soon to the App Store and Google Play.”

Composed from real assets at 2160×3840: actual wordmark, actual entry screen, App Store + Google Play badges with Coming Soon ribbons, weinfluenceher.org — on the app's own sparkle and foliage art.

From stills to the Reel

  1. Approve / swap frames — anything re-rolls in minutes.
  2. Animate — 4–6s vertical motion per frame; paint particles drift, the sunburst grows, the reflection lags a half-beat behind the real girl.
  3. Voice + music — warm narrator over a building soul-inflected bed; italics above are the working script. Captions burned in (Reels autoplay muted).
  4. Cuts — 30s hero Reel, 15s teaser, and 6s app-card bumper; the 16:9 set is retained for YouTube/web.
